mapper.sql: SELECT t.id, t.user_id, t.teacher_no, t.dept_id, t.title, t.research_area, t.create_time, t.update_time, su.real_name AS realName, su.gender AS gender, su.phone AS phone, su.email AS email, su.status AS status, d.dept_name AS deptName FROM teacher t INNER JOIN sys_user su ON su.id = t.user_id AND su.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN department d ON d.id = t.dept_id AND d.deleted = 0
